name: React-Native-Set-Live-Wallpaper
description: I built a cross-platform Expo and React Native module for setting static images and video-based live wallpapers through native Android and iOS workflows.
summary: I developed a TypeScript API backed by Kotlin and Swift implementations, supporting local or remote images, Android MP4 live wallpapers with interactive positioning, and iOS MP4-to-Live-Photo conversion. I designed the module around platform-supported user flows, with Android wallpaper previews and destinations plus iOS Photos export and asset cleanup. An Expo config plugin manages native wallpaper declarations and Photos permissions, while Jest tests and a strict TypeScript configuration support reliability and maintainability.

name: PanelPilot
description: I built PanelPilot, a privacy-focused Chrome extension that converts manga, comics, galleries, and other image-heavy pages into a distraction-free fullscreen reader.
summary: I developed panel-friendly navigation with zoom, mouse panning, keyboard shortcuts, adjustable autoplay, dockable controls, automatic image detection, and manual per-site training. I also designed an opt-in, searchable reading history that stores progress, zoom, image position, preferences, and trained profiles locally without requiring accounts or remote data collection. The extension uses a strict TypeScript architecture with separate background, content, popup, options, shared storage, and internationalization modules, demonstrating advanced browser-extension and frontend engineering skills.

name: vexa-booking
description: I built Vexa Booking, a full-stack operations platform for managing appointments, customers, employees, branches, checkout, inventory, commissions, and audit records.
summary: I developed the application with the Next.js App Router and strict TypeScript, using tRPC and TanStack Query for type-safe client-server data flows. I designed a Drizzle-backed Turso/libSQL data layer with versioned migrations and implemented protected workflows with Better Auth. The interface uses Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with next-intl providing Arabic-first RTL and English localization.
projectType: Full-stack booking and business operations web application

name: github-work-summory
description: I built an AI-powered CLI that analyzes GitHub repositories and generates evidence-based, portfolio- and resume-ready project summaries.
summary: I developed support for public and private repositories, authenticated batch selection, manifest-aware technology detection, GitHub metadata, and structured JSON output. I designed a modular TypeScript architecture spanning repository collection, browser automation, AI processing, configurable writing personalities, and multiple generation backends, including OpenAI-compatible APIs, Codex CLI, and Claude Code CLI. The project also includes automated tests for its AI, browser, technology-detection, and website-analysis components.

name: Cinemana Download Button
description: A browser extension script I created to inject a functional download interface directly into the Cinemana Shabakaty streaming platform.
summary: I built this extension utility to enhance media consumption by giving users direct access to video assets and subtitles. It utilizes content scripts for DOM manipulation and asynchronous event handling to intercept media streams and inject a seamless download interface into the host website.

name: Queen-Care
description: I built a full-stack, multilingual commerce platform that combines a web storefront, an administrative dashboard, and an Expo-powered mobile app in a shared TypeScript monorepo.
summary: I developed the customer-facing store and operations dashboard with Next.js and React, covering product, collection, brand, banner, order, review, discount-code, employee, and point-of-sale workflows. I designed shared tRPC API and Drizzle ORM schema packages so the web and React Native clients can reuse type-safe business logic and data models. The architecture also includes authentication, image uploads, notifications, email, localization, strict TypeScript configuration, and pnpm workspace tooling, demonstrating advanced cross-platform full-stack engineering.
projectType: Cross-platform e-commerce platform and administration system

name: hono-react-query
description: A specialized library I designed to provide a lightweight, tRPC-like mechanism for type-safe data fetching between Hono backends and React Query clients.
summary: I established this full-stack architectural pattern to simplify remote procedures. By automatically generating client types directly from the Hono backend schema, I mimicked the seamless, type-safe developer experience of tRPC while optimizing it specifically for the Hono framework.

name: API-Stress-Testing
description: A command-line tool I developed for conducting high-performance stress and load tests on target APIs.
summary: I built this CLI tool using the Autocannon benchmarking library inside the Bun runtime to measure critical performance metrics like throughput, average response times, and latency percentiles (P2.5 to P99). I added highly customizable command-line flags to give developers precise control over concurrency, duration, rate limits, and pipelining.

name: aquadeva-qr-code-gen
description: A strongly typed utility web application focused on precise, fast QR code generation.
summary: I engineered this web utility with a modern, framework-free approach using TypeScript to ensure strict type safety, disciplined code structure, and efficient rendering without adding unnecessary bundle weight.

name: Trello-Report
description: A reporting automation web application I built to extract data from Trello boards and generate structured tracking analytics.
summary: I created this utility to interface with the Trello REST API, using a modular architecture that cleanly separates API communication, data processing, and report generation logic. I leveraged TypeScript to handle asynchronous data manipulation securely and maintain strong type safety across the application.

name: mirai-perfumes
description: I built a full-stack perfume e-commerce platform that combines a customer storefront with an integrated operations dashboard.
summary: I developed the platform as a pnpm monorepo with separate Next.js applications for shopping and administration, backed by a shared, type-safe schema package using Drizzle ORM and Zod. The dashboard supports product, collection, brand, bundle, order, discount, review, employee, and point-of-sale workflows, while the storefront includes localized commerce experiences, authentication, email, uploads, and push-notification capabilities. The architecture demonstrates advanced full-stack engineering through strict TypeScript, shared validation and data models, tRPC APIs, responsive Tailwind CSS interfaces, and modular workspace design.
projectType: Full-stack e-commerce platform and administration dashboard

name: Expo Project Setup Boilerplate
description: A comprehensive, production-ready starter template I designed for building modern, cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo.
summary: I architected this advanced boilerplate to establish immediate mobile development best practices. It comes pre-configured with industry-standard solutions including Zustand for global state, TanStack Query for server caching, file-system routing via Expo Router, and robust localization using i18next.

name: Riches Car Rental
description: A responsive web application I created for managing car rentals and vehicle listings.
summary: I developed this system using a component-driven architecture to handle real-time inventory management. I focused heavily on strict typing and clean state management to ensure a reliable user workflow and responsive layout design.

name: lost-and-found
description: A functional web interface I designed to manage, log, and search for lost and found items.
summary: I implemented this platform to provide users with a structured system for item submissions, live status updates, and search queries. I relied on a full TypeScript codebase to guarantee type safety and maintain clean, reliable client-side operational logic.

name: Ebag-and-delivery-system
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform focused on bag retail, featuring product management and integrated delivery tracking logistics.
summary: I engineered this responsive full-stack platform to handle complete retail workflows from product selection to order fulfillment. I focused on building a secure, maintainable backend and frontend using TypeScript to seamlessly coordinate user interactions with the logistical delivery-tracking system.

name: Testing-bun-project
description: A TypeScript-based backend API playground I built for sandboxing and validating high-performance web services in the Bun ecosystem.
summary: I constructed this development environment to practice clean backend architectures using the high-performance Bun runtime. I integrated Express for routing, Prisma for database abstraction, JSON Web Tokens for authentication, and i18next for localization.

name: React Project Setup Boilerplate 2024
description: A standardized, highly scalable React web application boilerplate designed to enforce strict architectural best practices.
summary: I built this reusable boilerplate to codify my preferred development stack and eliminate repetitive configurations. It comes out-of-the-box with pre-integrated industry tools: Tailwind CSS for styling, React Router for seamless navigation, TanStack Query for efficient server state management, and full VitePWA integration for progressive offline-first web support.

name: Read-Sign
description: A highly structured front-end application focused on dynamic user interaction and text/visual data capturing.
summary: I engineered this front-end app to manage user workflows centered around signature inputs, visual displays, and data reading operations. I built the client architecture fully with TypeScript to maintain absolute structure and reliability.

name: Simple Warehouse Management System
description: A desktop-grade warehouse management application optimized for Windows environments to track inventory and handle dynamic order logistics.
summary: I developed this desktop system to resolve inventory and warehouse logistics tracking. It is built using standard web engines wrapped into a desktop architecture, utilizing TypeScript for the critical business logic to ensure robust data organization and modular UI components.

name: Seat Reservation System
description: An event-driven booking interface designed for real-time seat tracking and selection layouts in venues like cinemas and conference halls.
summary: I built this reservation application to manage seating configurations dynamically. It leverages reactive state workflows for real-time seat selections, utilizing TypeScript to guarantee strict control over checkout, user state, and event booking logic.

name: Work Holidays System
description: A lightweight web dashboard for viewing and organizing dynamic company holiday schedules.
summary: I created this front-end web utility to streamline internal shift planning. It relies entirely on client-side logic to handle interactive filtering and dynamic schedule rendering.

name: audio-player-NW_OPS_bot
description: A localized desktop media player integrated with a Telegram bot utility for internal network operations.
summary: I developed this specialized utility by combining a Telegram bot and a local system media layer using NW.js. This allowed me to bridge native desktop audio playback controls with event-driven server automation, managing deployment and environment setups using automated Batchfile scripting.

name: puppeteer-copy-content
description: A fast, automated web scraping CLI utility designed to extract full text layouts from web pages and output them to local files.
summary: I created this automation tool utilizing Puppeteer to script headlessly inside Chromium. It safely orchestrates asynchronous operations to handle modern client-side JavaScript rendering before securely parsing the page body and saving it to disk via Node's filesystem modules.

name: URL-Shrinker
description: A full-stack web-based URL redirection and shortening service with analytical tracking.
summary: I built this application utilizing an MVC design pattern with an Express.js backend and MongoDB database. It safely accepts long target URLs, converts them into short hash signatures, logs persistence metadata, and smoothly performs standard server-side redirects via dynamic templates.

name: react-project-setup
description: A modular frontend blueprint designed to accelerate React application setups and standardize folder scaling paths.
summary: I structured this reusable template to remove boilerplate overhead from my daily workflow. It establishes clean directory separations, optimal configuration files, and localized asset handling to help initiate feature-focused frontend architectures immediately.
